`AuthorityOwningRestoreAbandonmentTombstone<Role:AuthorityOwningRole>` is the generated role/profile-tagged immutable no-resurrection body `{authority_bound_header:AuthorityBoundHeader<Role>,skeleton_ref:RestoreAbandonmentTombstoneSkeletonRef<Role>,materialization_proof:RestoreAbandonmentTombstoneMaterializationProof<Role>,restore_id,restore_epoch,target_database_and_security_identity,target_incarnation,service_visibility_epoch,role_and_group,abandonment_authority_seed,abandon_operation_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreAbandonOperationRecord<Role>>,abandon_applied_identity,expected_role_valid_publication_subject_recipe,profile_applied_basis:ExternalCasCataloged{canonical_catalog_tombstone_terminal_import_ref,canonical_continuity_abandon_terminal_import_ref,returned_terminal_authority_head_commitment}|DirectoryBoundCataloged{canonical_catalog_tombstone_terminal_import_ref,creation_evidence_and_exact_target_manifest_inode_lineage,directory_bound_abandon_apply_identity,actual_result_root_slot_and_receipt_import_commitment}|DirectoryBoundEmbeddedNoCatalog{zero_catalog_applicability_proof,creation_evidence_and_exact_target_manifest_inode_lineage,directory_bound_abandon_apply_identity,actual_result_root_slot_and_receipt_import_commitment},permanent_no_service_and_no_same_incarnation_operational_successor_proof,higher_incarnation_only_rule,pending_pin_owner_ref:StrongRef<RestoreAbandonmentPinPendingOwner<Role>>,source_access_cleanup_and_release_latest_lease_obligation_commitment,replay_status_and_nonreuse_floor,body_digest}`. The DirectoryBound arms are materialized only by the later receipt-import command, after the apply root/slot and member receipt exist; the earlier apply result contains only skeleton/pending owner/recipes.

`ShardRestoreAbandonmentTombstone` is the distinct `{authority_binding:AuthorityBindingFor<Shard>,skeleton_ref:RestoreAbandonmentTombstoneSkeletonRef<Shard>,materialization_proof:RestoreAbandonmentTombstoneMaterializationProof<Shard>,restore_id,restore_epoch,shard_id,target_database_and_security_identity,target_incarnation,service_visibility_epoch,abandonment_authority_seed,participant_apply_authorization_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<GlobalRestoreAbandonParticipantApplyCertificate>,own_entry_ordinal,source_meta_abandon_operation_public_commitment,own_no_target_observation_proof_ref:StrongRef<RestoreNoTargetObservationProof<Shard>>,shard_abandon_apply_identity,certified_manifest_receipt_and_profile_terminal_commitments,pending_pin_owner_ref:StrongRef<RestoreAbandonmentPinPendingOwner<Shard>>,permanent_no_service_and_no_same_incarnation_successor_proof,higher_incarnation_only_rule,source_access_cleanup_projection_and_replay_floor,body_digest}`. It has no `RestoreAbandonOperationRecord<Shard>`, raw Meta strong ref, or canonical external import owned by Meta. `RestoreAbandonmentTombstoneRef<Role>` is the generated exact family `Local{ref:StrongRef<AuthorityOwningRestoreAbandonmentTombstone<Local>>}|Meta{ref:StrongRef<AuthorityOwningRestoreAbandonmentTombstone<Meta>>}|Shard{ref:StrongRef<ShardRestoreAbandonmentTombstone>}`.

Every repeated field and filled hole must byte-match its skeleton/materialization proof; a tombstone identity is computed only after those inputs exist and is never part of a predecessor recipe. Both tombstone forms own protected evidence and therefore retain a full authority binding until checked compaction creates a separate payload-free digest tombstone. Later publication evidence, installed terminal pin basis, acknowledgements, and source-release terminal live in their own later objects and byte-match the precommitted seed/recipes. This split prevents tombstone/root/receipt/pin cycles while preserving permanent nonresurrection evidence.

`RestoreAbandonAuthorityProfileProjection<Role:AuthorityOwningRole>` is the generated reference-free closed union `ExternalCasCataloged{abandonment_authority_seed,canonical_catalog_cleanup_projection,expected_continuity_head_commitment,canonical_continuity_abandon_predecessor_and_action_body_projection}|DirectoryBoundCataloged{abandonment_authority_seed,creation_evidence_public_commitment,fixed_local_continuity_digest,canonical_catalog_cleanup_projection,expected_local_state_root_and_assigned_slot_recipe_public_commitment,local_abandon_publication_recipe_digest}|DirectoryBoundEmbeddedNoCatalog{abandonment_authority_seed,creation_evidence_public_commitment,fixed_local_continuity_digest,zero_catalog_applicability_proof_digest,expected_local_state_root_and_assigned_slot_recipe_public_commitment,local_abandon_publication_recipe_digest}`; DirectoryBound arms exist only for Local. After its audit visibility advance, `RestoreAbandonmentManifest` is the reference-free signed closed union with common `{restore_id,restore_epoch,target_database_and_security_identity,target_incarnation,service_visibility_epoch,abandonment_authority_seed,abandon_operation_record_public_commitment,authority_profile_projection,source_lease_identity_and_disposition:ReleaseLatestLineageRequired,profile_specific_predecessor_and_operation_action_body_commitments,permanent_no_service_and_higher_incarnation_only_rule,signer_set_epoch,signatures,body_digest}` and exactly one posture body: `Local{target_tombstone_skeleton_recipe,no_target_observation_proof_public_commitment,local_pending_owner_public_commitment}|Sharded{meta_tombstone_skeleton_recipe,meta_no_target_observation_proof_public_commitment,required_group_and_topology_commitment,meta_pending_owner_public_commitment,sorted_shard_entries[{shard_id,no_target_observation_proof_public_commitment,tombstone_skeleton_recipe:RestoreAbandonmentTombstoneSkeletonRecipe<Shard>,pending_owner_recipe:RestoreAbandonmentPinPendingOwnerRecipe<Shard>,recipe_availability_and_retention_certificate}],complete_entry_bijection}`. It contains complete portable recipes/projections rather than local refs, so every Shard can materialize its skeleton without a raw Meta object. The manifest commits action bodies that bind only the earlier seed; neither action body points back to the manifest. `ExternalCasRestoreAbandonmentReceiptRef` is the generated tag-refined strong reference to only `RestoreAbandonmentReceipt::ExternalCasCataloged`. The sequences are noninterchangeable:

- `ExternalCasCataloged`: canonical cleanup first installs or joins the exact target-epoch `CatalogAuthorityHead::TombstonedNoEndpoint` successor without touching any older operational endpoint, then dispatches only `CanonicalRestoreContinuityAbandonContract<Role>` and changes the exact registered `RestoreAbandonableContinuityPredecessor` to `RestoreAbandoned{restore_id,target_incarnation,service_visibility_epoch,abandonment_basis:CanonicalRooted{abandonment_authority_seed_digest,target_tombstone_skeleton_digest,prior_lease_closure_disposition},retired_through_incarnation,no_operational_successor_at_this_incarnation}`. The no-mutation dispositions exist only in the no-root prebootstrap cleanup path.
- `DirectoryBoundCataloged`: the canonical catalog tombstone is installed first. Ordered `DirectoryBoundAbandonApplySpec {authority_bound_header,restore_id,abandon_operation_record_ref,skeleton_ref,pending_owner_ref,catalog_terminal_disposition,current_creation_evidence_ref,live_target_manifest_inode_lease_and_publication_sequencer,fixed_local_continuity_digest,exact_predecessor_root_and_slot,assigned_result_slot_generation,expected_result_payload_manifest_and_receipt_body_recipes_excluding_all_result_and_tombstone_digests,terminal_audit_gate}` then clears `restore_state_ref`, selects `RecoveryAbandoned`, and enters `AbandonedAuthorityAppliedAwaitingReceipt` under the same inode fence. That result contains only its assigned apply identity, skeleton, pending owner, current source-lease owner, and the acyclic recipes—**no tombstone, actual result-root/slot digest, or receipt**. Only after that RootSlot is durable may a member issue `DirectoryBoundAbandonmentReceipt {FenceBoundIrreversibleReceiptHeader,restore_id,abandon_apply_identity,prior_root_and_slot,result_root_complete_bytes_digest_and_slot_generation,catalog_tombstone_terminal_commitment,creation_evidence_and_fixed_continuity_commitment,no_service_and_permanent_no_operational_successor_proof,receipt_body_recipe_match_digest}`. Ordered `DirectoryBoundAbandonReceiptImportSpec` consumes that receipt, the awaiting-receipt root, skeleton, pending owner, and exact result publication evidence; it fills the DirectoryBound holes, materializes `AuthorityOwningRestoreAbandonmentTombstone<Local>`, and enters `AbandonedAwaitingTerminalPin`. Its tombstone names the earlier apply result/receipt, never the receipt-import result that contains it.
- `DirectoryBoundEmbeddedNoCatalog`: the same local apply/receipt sequence runs with the zero-catalog-applicability proof and no catalog operation or placeholder version.

Sharded abandonment has an explicit Meta-to-Shard authority bridge; a Shard never acts from prose, a raw external receipt, or a digest-only projection. After the ExternalCas catalog/continuity terminal imports and `RestoreAbandonmentReceipt::ExternalCasCataloged` are durable, Meta orders `GlobalRestoreAbandonParticipantApplyAuthorizeSpec {restore_id,restore_epoch,abandon_operation_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreAbandonOperationRecord<Meta>>,abandonment_manifest_ref:StrongRef<RestoreAbandonmentManifest>,external_abandonment_receipt_ref:ExternalCasRestoreAbandonmentReceiptRef,meta_no_target_observation_proof_ref,exact_sorted_shard_no_observation_refs,expected_source_meta_prefix_and_configuration,required_shard_set_and_topology_commitment,meta_pending_owner_ref,sorted_shard_recipe_entries[{shard_id,tombstone_skeleton_recipe:RestoreAbandonmentTombstoneSkeletonRecipe<Shard>,pending_owner_recipe:RestoreAbandonmentPinPendingOwnerRecipe<Shard>,recipe_availability_and_retention_certificate}],complete_proof_recipe_shard_and_group_bijection,terminal_audit_gate}`. Apply remains hidden, freezes that exact participant set and complete recipe map, and contains no future certificate. Only after its audit visibility advance may a certificate attempt create `GlobalRestoreAbandonParticipantApplyCertificate {SameGroupCertificateHeader,restore_id,restore_epoch,authorization_applied_identity,abandon_operation_record_identity,abandonment_manifest_identity_and_digest,external_receipt_identity_and_digest,source_meta_prefix_and_configuration,required_shard_set_and_topology_commitment,sorted_shard_entries[{shard_id,no_target_observation_proof_identity,tombstone_skeleton_recipe,pending_owner_recipe,recipe_availability_and_retention_certificate}],complete_entry_bijection,post_authorization_global_state_root_ref:StrongRef<GlobalStateRoot>,root_slot_durability_digest,visibility_certificate_ref:StrongRef<PortableSemanticVisibilityCertificate<Meta>>,certificate_attempt_ref:StrongRef<CertificateAttemptRecord>,canonical_signature_set}`.

Each Shard locally expands and verifies only its certified recipe bytes, then orders `ShardRestoreAbandonApplySpec {authorization_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<GlobalRestoreAbandonParticipantApplyCertificate>,own_entry_ordinal,own_no_target_observation_proof_ref:StrongRef<RestoreNoTargetObservationProof<Shard>>,current_restore_state_ref:StrongRef<RestoreState>,current_registry_ref:StrongRef<RestoreRegistry>,current_source_lease_projection_ref:StrongRef<ShardRestoreSourceLeaseProjection>,constructed_tombstone_skeleton_ref:RestoreAbandonmentTombstoneSkeletonRef<Shard>,constructed_pending_owner_ref:StrongRef<RestoreAbandonmentPinPendingOwner<Shard>>,complete_recipe_expansion_availability_and_entry_match_proof,expected_source_meta_prefix_configuration_and_topology}` under the matching `ShardControlAuthority::MetaAuthorized` arm. Apply clears `restore_state_ref`, selects RecoveryAbandoned, materializes the role-correct Shard tombstone from the certified basis, installs `RestoreRetentionAnchor::AbandonmentPinPending`, and enters `AbandonedAwaitingTerminalPin`; it contains no future publication evidence, pin, or acknowledgement. After the role-valid abandonment-pin install and the separate Shard source-access close transition, the Shard may create exact `RestoreShardAbandonAck {SameGroupCertificateHeader,authorization_certificate_identity,restore_id,restore_epoch,shard_id,abandon_apply_applied_identity,abandonment_pin_install_applied_identity,source_access_close_applied_identity,abandonment_tombstone_ref:StrongRef<ShardRestoreAbandonmentTombstone>,abandoned_terminal_pin_basis_ref:AbandonedRestoreTerminalPinBasisRef<Shard>,source_access_closure_ref:StrongRef<ShardRestoreSourceAccessClosure>,terminalizing_projection_commitment,post_close_shard_state_root_ref:StrongRef<ShardLogicalStateRoot>,root_slot_durability_digest,source_lease_projection_identity_generation_and_digest,no_service_and_no_same_incarnation_successor_commitment,certificate_attempt_ref:StrongRef<CertificateAttemptRecord>,canonical_signature_set}`. `GlobalRestoreAbandonFinalizeSpec` consumes the same authorization, manifest, external receipt, Meta pending owner, and every-and-only required certified Shard ack; missing, duplicate, wrong-configuration, wrong-recipe, wrong-disposition, missing source-access closure, or wrong-restore acknowledgements remain blocking. It then creates the Meta abandonment tombstone and enters Meta `AbandonedAwaitingTerminalPin`. This order ensures no Meta terminal can discard the participant recipe/proof/closure before all Shards have durably accepted it.

`RestoreAbandonmentReceipt` is the portable closed union `ExternalCasCataloged{catalog_tombstone_lineage,continuity_abandon_lineage,complete_profile_stage_bijection}|DirectoryBoundCataloged{catalog_tombstone_lineage,directory_bound_abandonment_receipt_bytes_and_digest,complete_profile_stage_bijection}|DirectoryBoundEmbeddedNoCatalog{directory_bound_abandonment_receipt_bytes_and_digest,zero_catalog_applicability_proof_digest,complete_profile_stage_bijection}`. A DirectoryBound local apply contains only skeleton/pending-owner/result/receipt recipes, never its future tombstone, receipt, or result digest. Reversing a cataloged profile's order is illegal because it could leave an unowned endpoint reservation. For ExternalCas, `LocalRestoreAbandonFinalizeSpec` consumes the exact canonical profile evidence, clears `restore_state_ref`, selects `RecoveryAbandoned`, materializes the Local tombstone, and enters `AbandonedAwaitingTerminalPin`; for DirectoryBound, `DirectoryBoundAbandonReceiptImportSpec` is the sole tombstone materializer and transition from `AbandonedAuthorityAppliedAwaitingReceipt`. `ShardRestoreAbandonApplySpec` and `GlobalRestoreAbandonFinalizeSpec` likewise end in their role-specific `AbandonedAwaitingTerminalPin`, never directly in participant-complete or cleanup. After each such root is durable, the role constructs publication evidence, inventory, pin-ledger activation evidence, and basis; the role-specific abandonment-pin install enters AwaitingSourceAccessCleanup or the Shard awaiting-source-closure state. Only after exact Shard source-access closure may it create an abandon ack; only after Local/Meta progress generation zero may cleanup begin. RecoveryAbandoned also admits exact prebootstrap-evidence canonicalization, re-encryption/journal-key destruction, detailed-evidence cut, receipt recovery, abandonment-pin installation, source-access cleanup, lease renewal/close/release/finalize, participant pin release, and registered tombstone compaction under RecoveryCommitCx. It rejects ordinary open, service, sessions, capabilities, user work, unrelated maintenance, reconfiguration, and resurrection. These evidence-maintenance successors are included in the seal/allowed-successor registry so a delayed journal-key cut cannot deadlock release. A later same-identity restore must reserve a strictly higher incarnation.

## Invariants & interactions
Consumes the prebootstrap journal, source cleanup/pin families, continuity profiles, catalog authority, audit terminal contracts, universal dispatch, and role-exact restore registry. Canonical restore transform may reach this terminal path; promotion and W12 restore must prove they did not.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Exact schemas/rows cover skeleton, pin-pending owner, no-observation proof, predecessor, operation, manifest, Local/Meta/Shard apply/ack/certificate, cleanup and final tombstone/anchor states.
- Unit/golden tests freeze every role arm, reason class, catalog/continuity basis, observation proof, participant set, pin basis, and compact public projection.
- Property/model tests prove abandonment and promotion are mutually exclusive, no serve/read authority in abandoned phases, every target object/reservation/key/lease has one disposition, and terminal evidence prevents ID/retry reuse.
- Mutation/fuzz rejects wrong role/group/restore, stale catalog predecessor, incomplete participant set, forged no-observation, missing pin, live key/object edge, cross-plane terminal evidence, and hidden reason leakage.
- Crash/DPOR E2E abandons before first root, during reconciliation, and after hidden participant roots; restart at every dispatch/CAS/apply/ack/pin boundary converges to one rooted nonservable terminal state. The harness uses isolated fixtures and simulated loss, never destructive deletion of user/repository files.
- JSONL emits {event_version,restore_id,role_and_group,phase,abandon_reason_class,observation_proof_digest?,catalog_predecessor_digest?,continuity_predecessor_digest?,operation_id?,participant_count,participant_ack_count,pin_state,cleanup_inventory_digest,terminal_manifest_digest?,recovery_action,replay_command}; public logs use padded reason classes and omit protected evidence bodies.

## Risks & rejected alternatives
Rejected: deleting staging and forgetting the attempt, mutable abandoned markers, inferred no-observation, catalog update without exact predecessor, and promotion after an abandonment arm. Evidence retention is intentionally permanent enough to prevent resurrection.

## Provenance
Plan Appendix A lines 2415-2447.

title: Implement restore bridge, reconciliation proof, and role readiness certificates
description:
## What & scope
Implement the canonical bridge, reconciliation-completion proof, continuity/allocation authority handoff, ready-closure inventory, and Local/Meta/Shard readiness certificate ladder. This task is the exact boundary between a transformed hidden database and one eligible for promotion preparation.

## Why
Completing object transformation is not readiness. Identity, allocation, privacy, audit, key, result/cursor, replay, configuration, remote retention, prepared ownership, and service obligations must all reconcile to one rooted basis. A single omitted class can resurrect old authority or serve inconsistent state.

## Design — exact normative contract
`RestoreReconciliationEvidenceRef<Role>` and `RestoreExplicitRetentionOwnerRef<Role>` are generated closed tagged unions over the role-valid `RegisteredStrongRef` targets for identity/allocation, privacy, audit, prepared/decision, cursor/delivery, resource, key, remote retention/trust, history, replay, backup, DP, derived state, and capability invalidation. `RestoreReconciliationRoot<Role>` has exactly one generated slot per activated class; each value is `Pending{reason_code}|Resolved{evidence:RestoreReconciliationEvidenceRef<Role>}|ExplicitlyRetained{owner:RestoreExplicitRetentionOwnerRef<Role>,floor,expiry_or_terminal_rule}|Disabled{exact_fail_closed_policy}`. `RestoreReconciliationCompletionProof<Role>` is `{restore_id,restore_epoch,role_and_group,reconciliation_root_ref:StrongRef<RestoreReconciliationRoot<Role>>,activated_slot_bitmap,resolved_slot_bitmap,explicitly_retained_slot_bitmap,disabled_slot_bitmap,zero_pending_proof,all_explicit_retention_rules_live_proof,complete_transform_projection_coverage_digest,checker_version}`. The four bitmaps are disjoint and exhaustive. `RestoreReconciliationStatus<Role>` is `Pending{unresolved_slot_bitmap}|Complete{proof_ref:StrongRef<RestoreReconciliationCompletionProof<Role>>}`; no nullable proof or inferred readiness exists.

`RestoreContinuityBasis<Role>` is the generated exact role family `Local{basis:DirectoryBound{creation_evidence_ref:StrongRef<DirectoryBoundCreationEvidence<Local>>,fixed_local_continuity_digest,target_manifest_inode_identity_and_fence_commitment}|ExternalCas{continuity_record_ref:StrongRef<ClusterIncarnationContinuityRecord>,head_digest_and_cas_version,recovery_lease_generation_and_lineage_commitment}}|Meta{continuity_record_ref:StrongRef<ClusterIncarnationContinuityRecord>,head_digest_and_cas_version,recovery_lease_generation_and_lineage_commitment}|Shard{continuity_projection_ref:StrongRef<ShardContinuityAuthorityProjection>,source_meta_prefix_and_configuration,projected_head_digest_and_cas_version,recovery_only_member_lease_projection_commitment}`. Meta has no DirectoryBound arm; Shard has no raw continuity record/CAS authority. `RecoveryBridgeSourceLeaseBasis<Role>` is the generated exact `Local{lease_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceLeaseRecord<Local>>,generation,portable_lease_state_digest}|Meta{lease_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceLeaseRecord<Meta>>,generation,portable_lease_state_digest}|Shard{lease_projection_ref:StrongRef<ShardRestoreSourceLeaseProjection>,generation,portable_lease_state_digest,certified_source_meta_prefix_and_configuration}`. Every field byte-matches `RecoveryBridgeAuthority<Role>`.

`RestoreStateCommon<Role>` is `{restore_id,restore_epoch,source_posture,source_manifest_identity,source_backup_incarnation,externally_retired_incarnation_floor,target_incarnation,service_visibility_epoch,target_role_and_group,continuity_basis:RestoreContinuityBasis<Role>,transform_plan_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationTransformPlan<Role>>,projection_result_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationProjectionResult<Role>>,source_lease_basis:RecoveryBridgeSourceLeaseBasis<Role>,target_configuration_and_topology_identity,reconciliation_root_ref:StrongRef<RestoreReconciliationRoot<Role>>,reconciliation_status:RestoreReconciliationStatus<Role>,service_gate:Hidden,state_generation}`.

`RestoreState` is the closed role union `Local{common:RestoreStateCommon<Local>,phase:Reconciling|VisibilityCommitted{activation_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}|ServicePreparedHidden{prepare_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}}|Meta{common:RestoreStateCommon<Meta>,phase:Reconciling|ActivationOrdered{activation_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}|VisibilityCommitted{visibility_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}|ServicePreparedHidden{prepare_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}}|Shard{common:RestoreStateCommon<Shard>,shard_id,phase:Reconciling|ActivationAppliedHidden{activation_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}|VisibilityApplied{visibility_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}|ServicePreparedHidden{prepare_applied_ref:AuthorityAppliedRef}}`. The generated role validator accepts only the matching Local, Meta, or Shard `AuthorityAppliedRef` arm. A ready certificate/barrier may be signed only over `Reconciling + Complete`; it is owned outside `RestoreState` by the certificate ledger after the source root exists. Each applied phase stores only its already identified input command plus assigned order—never the future command record, resulting root, post-apply certificate, or acknowledgement. `ServicePreparedHidden` additionally requires exact visibility evidence but does not clear the state or service gate. No ordinary work, session admission, endpoint advertisement, capability issuance, or result delivery is legal while `restore_state_ref` is present.

`RecoveryBridgeDependencyRef<Role>` is the generated closed union of role-valid recreated signing/wrap/verifier authority, identity/privacy/audit reconciliation-plan, and prepared/cursor/delivery/remote-obligation plan objects. `RecoveryBridgeAuthority<Role>` is the generated role family `Local{direct_creation_authority_ref:StrongRef<RestoreDirectCreationAuthorityRecord<Local>>,source_acquisition_bundle_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceAcquisitionBundle<Local>>,latest_source_lease_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceLeaseRecord<Local>>}|Meta{direct_creation_authority_ref:StrongRef<RestoreDirectCreationAuthorityRecord<Meta>>,source_acquisition_bundle_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceAcquisitionBundle<Meta>>,latest_source_lease_record_ref:StrongRef<RestoreSourceLeaseRecord<Meta>>}|Shard{certified_meta_bootstrap_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<RestoreShardBootstrapProjectionCertificate>,source_meta_prefix_configuration_and_trust_commitment,source_lease_projection_ref:StrongRef<ShardRestoreSourceLeaseProjection>}`. Only the matching arm is inhabitable.

`InitialRestoreStateRef<Role>` is the generated tag-refined strong reference whose Local, Meta, and Shard concrete validators accept only the matching `RestoreState` role arm in `Reconciling` with `service_gate=Hidden`, complete role-valid common identity, and no future applied phase. `InitialRestoreRegistryRef<Role>` is the generated tag-refined strong reference whose Local/Meta validators accept only `Nonterminal{phase=ActiveHidden{restore_state_ref=the exact InitialRestoreStateRef<Role>},lease_state=Current{latest matching source lease record}}` and whose Shard validator accepts only `ActiveHidden` with the exact initial state, certified source-lease projection, transform/projection, Meta prefix/configuration, and no terminal/pin state. A generic `StrongRef<RestoreState|RestoreRegistry>` cannot inhabit a recovery bridge.

`RecoveryAllocationEpochAuthority<Role>` is the generated closed role family `Local{allocation_claim_import_ref:StrongRef<PreBootstrapReservationClaimCanonicalImportRecord<Local,AllocationEpoch>>,bootstrap_applied_use_identity:BootstrapReservationAppliedUseIdentity<Local,AllocationEpoch>,expected_initial_allocator_state_and_spent_range_recipe_commitment}|Meta{allocation_claim_import_ref:StrongRef<PreBootstrapReservationClaimCanonicalImportRecord<Meta,AllocationEpoch>>,bootstrap_applied_use_identity:BootstrapReservationAppliedUseIdentity<Meta,AllocationEpoch>,expected_initial_allocator_state_and_spent_range_recipe_commitment}|Shard{authority_projection_ref:StrongRef<ShardAllocationEpochAuthorityProjection>,expected_initial_allocator_state_recipe_commitment}`. Local/Meta byte-match the exact claim import and the corresponding entry in the pending creation guard; Shard byte-matches only its certified consumer-local slice projection and never encodes a reservation head, receipt, or Local/Meta import.

`RecoveryBridgeSpec<Role>` is the exact role-specialized first-control body `{restore_id,restore_epoch,authority:RecoveryBridgeAuthority<Role>,source_manifest_identity_and_digest,transform_plan_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationTransformPlan<Role>>,projection_result_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationProjectionResult<Role>>,source_lease_basis:RecoveryBridgeSourceLeaseBasis<Role>,target_role_payload:RoleGeneratedRecoveryPayload<Role>,initial_restore_state_ref:InitialRestoreStateRef<Role>,initial_restore_registry_ref:InitialRestoreRegistryRef<Role>,initial_protocol_state_recipe_commitment,target_checkpoint_floor_and_prepared_consensus_body_recipe_commitments,allocation_epoch_authority:RecoveryAllocationEpochAuthority<Role>,dependency_refs[RecoveryBridgeDependencyRef<Role>],dependency_coverage_bitmap,complete_posture_field_slot_plane_and_object_coverage_digest,terminal_audit_gate:StructurallyInapplicable{RecoverySystemAuthority}}`. `RoleGeneratedRecoveryPayload<Local>` is `{target_configuration_ref,assigned_logical_command_origin}`; Meta adds topology and assigned global origin; Shard is `{shard_id,target_configuration_ref,target_topology_epoch,assigned_shard_raft_origin,certified_meta_bootstrap_identity}`. A Shard spec cannot encode Local/Meta external-authority refs.

The spec carries already-authenticated recipe commitments and earlier objects only, never future Protocol/Prepared/Consensus/manifest/slot identities. Its mode/role must match the guard, transform/projection, initial state/registry, and protocol recipe. Initial `RestoreState` and registry are built before the spec, hidden `Reconciling`/`ActiveHidden`, and name neither the spec nor future records. `RecoveryBridgeSpec<Local|Meta>` is consumed only by `PendingRestoreCreationGuard<Role>`; `RecoveryBridgeSpec<Shard>` only by `PendingShardRestoreCreationGuard` and outer `ShardControlAuthority::MetaAuthorized` naming the same certified bootstrap projection. Apply constructs the role payload and real role-valid command record, then the guard builds Protocol, Prepared, Consensus, manifest, and slot roots in universal order. Fresh Genesis alone has no head; restore never validates an old root as current and never creates a headless non-Genesis state.

`RestoreReadyClosureRef<Role>` is a generated closed union over the role-valid checkpoint/vector/floor/history/prepared/certificate/key/derived/remote-obligation/configuration roots, and `RestoreReadyClosureInventory<Role>` is `{role_and_group,sorted_refs[RestoreReadyClosureRef<Role>],exhaustive_coverage_bitmap,inventory_digest}`. No raw `[StrongRef]` bag is legal. For sharded restore, `RestoreShardReadyBarrier {SameGroupCertificateHeader,restore_id,restore_epoch,service_visibility_epoch,shard_id,target_domain,exact_global_barrier,target_topology_and_configuration,local_projection_result_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationProjectionResult<Shard>>,state_root_ref:StrongRef<ShardLogicalStateRoot>,ready_closure_inventory_ref:StrongRef<RestoreReadyClosureInventory<Shard>>,active_meta_projection_root_ref:StrongRef<ActiveMetaProjectionRoot>,reconciliation_completion_proof_ref:StrongRef<RestoreReconciliationCompletionProof<Shard>>,local_root_slot_durability_digest,one_digest_signer_lock_ref,quorum_signatures}` strongly owns the exact local closure. Its completion proof allows both Resolved and ExplicitlyRetained slots and rejects any Pending slot.

`GlobalRestoreActivationSpec` is `{restore_id,expected_meta_state:WeakStateIdentity,exact_global_barrier,expected_topology_and_meta_configuration,meta_reconciliation_proof_ref:StrongRef<RestoreReconciliationCompletionProof<Meta>>,meta_ready_closure_inventory_ref:StrongRef<RestoreReadyClosureInventory<Meta>>,exact_sorted_ready_barrier_refs[CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<RestoreShardReadyBarrier>],complete_group_partition_and_authority_commitment,continuity_reservation_digest,recovery_lease_generation,service_visibility_epoch,terminal_audit_gate}`. After apply and the exact audit visibility advance, Meta creates `GlobalRestoreActivationCertificate {SameGroupCertificateHeader,restore_id,activation_record_ref:StrongRef<GlobalControlRecord>,exact_global_barrier,topology_and_meta_configuration_identity,sorted_ready_barrier_identities,complete_group_partition_and_authority_commitment,post_apply_global_state_root_ref:StrongRef<GlobalStateRoot>,service_visibility_epoch,visibility_certificate_ref:StrongRef<PortableSemanticVisibilityCertificate<Meta>>,one_digest_signer_lock_ref,quorum_signatures}`. `ShardRestoreActivationApplySpec` is `{activation_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<GlobalRestoreActivationCertificate>,own_ready_barrier_ref:StrongRef<RestoreShardReadyBarrier>,expected_local_restore_state:WeakStateIdentity,expected_topology_configuration_and_remote_trust_selector,exact_typed_restore_projection_payload}` and leaves the shard hidden. Its `ShardControlAuthority` compatibility row requires `MetaAuthorized` with that exact activation CRSR; there is no duplicate authority field in the body. It then emits `RestoreShardActivationAck {SameGroupCertificateHeader,restore_id,activation_identity,ready_barrier_identity,post_apply_state_root_ref:StrongRef<ShardLogicalStateRoot>,applied_shard_raft_index,exact_global_barrier,service_visibility_epoch,service_gate:Hidden,root_slot_durability_digest,audit_visibility_prefix,one_digest_signer_lock_ref,quorum_signatures}`.

`RestoreVisibilityCommitSpec` is `{restore_id,activation_record_ref:StrongRef<GlobalControlRecord>,activation_certificate_ref:StrongRef<GlobalRestoreActivationCertificate>,exact_sorted_activation_ack_refs[CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<RestoreShardActivationAck>],expected_meta_restore_state:WeakStateIdentity,expected_topology_and_configurations,complete_required_shard_commitment,service_visibility_epoch,terminal_audit_gate}`. It makes Meta `VisibilityCommitted` but still service-hidden and, after its audit visibility advance, yields `RestoreVisibilityCommitCertificate {SameGroupCertificateHeader,restore_id,visibility_record_ref:StrongRef<GlobalControlRecord>,activation_identity,sorted_activation_ack_identities,topology_and_configuration_commitment,post_apply_global_state_root_ref:StrongRef<GlobalStateRoot>,service_visibility_epoch,visibility_certificate_ref:StrongRef<PortableSemanticVisibilityCertificate<Meta>>,one_digest_signer_lock_ref,quorum_signatures}`. Each shard orders `ShardRestoreVisibilityApplySpec {visibility_commit_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<RestoreVisibilityCommitCertificate>,own_activation_ack_ref:StrongRef<RestoreShardActivationAck>,expected_local_restore_state:WeakStateIdentity,service_visibility_epoch}`; its outer authority row requires `MetaAuthorized` with that visibility CRSR. It becomes `VisibilityApplied` but remains hidden and emits `RestoreShardVisibilityAck {SameGroupCertificateHeader,restore_id,visibility_commit_identity,own_activation_ack_identity,post_apply_state_root_ref:StrongRef<ShardLogicalStateRoot>,applied_shard_raft_index,service_visibility_epoch,service_gate:Hidden,root_slot_durability_digest,audit_visibility_prefix,one_digest_signer_lock_ref,quorum_signatures}`.

Service opening is acyclic and receipt-first. `GlobalRestoreServicePrepareSpec` is `{restore_id,visibility_commit_ref:StrongRef<RestoreVisibilityCommitCertificate>,exact_sorted_visibility_ack_refs[CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<RestoreShardVisibilityAck>],expected_meta_restore_state:WeakStateIdentity,exact_topology_configuration_and_endpoint_set,promotion_authority_basis:ExternalCasCataloged{expected_restore_reserved_or_clone_reserved_continuity_digest_and_cas_version,expected_catalog_predecessor_version},service_visibility_epoch,terminal_audit_gate}`. W12/Meta requires `ExternalCasCataloged`; neither DirectoryBound arm is inhabitable. It remains `RecoveryReconciling`, installs Meta `ServicePreparedHidden`, and after its audit visibility advance creates `GlobalRestoreServicePrepareCertificate {SameGroupCertificateHeader,restore_id,prepare_record_ref:StrongRef<GlobalControlRecord>,visibility_commit_identity,sorted_visibility_ack_identities,topology_configuration_endpoint_commitment,promotion_authority_basis,service_visibility_epoch,visibility_certificate_ref:StrongRef<PortableSemanticVisibilityCertificate<Meta>>,one_digest_signer_lock_ref,quorum_signatures}`.

Each shard orders `ShardRestoreServicePrepareSpec {prepare_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<GlobalRestoreServicePrepareCertificate>,own_visibility_ack_ref:StrongRef<RestoreShardVisibilityAck>,expected_local_restore_state:WeakStateIdentity,expected_topology_configuration_and_remote_trust_selector,service_visibility_epoch}` under the outer exact `MetaAuthorized` row, remains hidden, and emits `RestoreShardServiceReadyAck {SameGroupCertificateHeader,restore_id,prepare_identity,own_visibility_ack_identity,post_prepare_state_root_ref:StrongRef<ShardLogicalStateRoot>,applied_shard_raft_index,service_visibility_epoch,service_gate:Hidden,root_slot_durability_digest,one_digest_signer_lock_ref,quorum_signatures}`.

## Invariants & interactions
Consumes restore transform/reconciliation, abandonment alternative, prior-lease/reservation barriers, source cleanup/pins, exact authority/time/continuity contracts, and generated mandatory inventory. Promotion, service open, independent reopen, completion, source release, and W12 restore depend on its certificates.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Exact schemas/rows cover reconciliation proof, continuity basis, bridge authority, allocation authority, ready inventory, role certificates/barriers, and every typed obligation class/floor.
- Unit/golden tests freeze full inventory ordering, role certificates, source/target commitments, visibility/service state, and no-future-reference construction DAG.
- Property/model tests prove exhaustive class coverage, one source-to-target mapping, no old ordinary authority, no service admission, allocation monotonicity, role-set completeness, and mutually exclusive abandonment/promotion readiness.
- Mutation/fuzz deletes/substitutes each obligation class, role participant, root, visibility position, policy/revocation/key/time binding, reservation disposition, result/cursor owner, replay/grant, or prepared closure; every case fails closed.
- Crash/DPOR E2E resumes from every reconciliation import/checkpoint/certificate/publication boundary and independently recomputes the entire ready inventory before proceeding.
- JSONL emits {event_version,restore_id,role_and_group,reconciliation_generation,obligation_class,expected_count,observed_count,missing_or_extra_digest?,continuity_basis_digest,allocation_authority_digest,ready_inventory_digest,certificate_kind,certificate_digest,visibility_state,service_state,recovery_action,replay_command}; protected object refs are commitment-only/redacted.

## Risks & rejected alternatives
Rejected: one boolean reconciled flag, hand-maintained inventory lists, readiness inferred from transform completion, Shard self-authorization, and serving during RecoveryReconciling. Missing any generated class keeps the database hidden.

## Provenance
Plan Appendix A lines 2541-2567.

title: Implement RestoreSourceLease lifecycle: acquire, renew, release, lineage proofs
description:
## What & scope
Implement the archive-owned `RestoreSourceLease`: prebootstrap acquisition (before a target database exists), canonical import, renewal, renewal-close, release, lineage checkpoints/proofs, and the restore registry's lease-state machine. This is the authority under which all archived content crosses into a restore.

## Why (bets, market, goals)
Restore cannot reuse the source database's backup pin (released after publication) and cannot trust a bare manifest file: it needs a live, externally linearized lease against the archive authority binding exactly one backup subject set to exactly one target holder. B5: the lease lineage is fork-proof (CAS chain + signed lineage proofs + checkpoints), and every renewal/release is an idempotent external operation with permanent operation-ID nonreuse.

## Design — normative detail
`RestoreSourceLeaseIdentity` is `{restore_id,source_backup_identity:{source_database_id,source_database_security_namespace_id,source_cluster_incarnation,backup_id,backup_manifest_digest,publication_bundle_id,archive_retention_grant_id,archive_grant_subject_set_digest,archive_inventory_root_digest,permitted_inventory_digest},target_holder_identity:{target_database_id,target_database_security_namespace_id,target_incarnation,target_service_visibility_epoch,recovery_authority_digest},archive_authority_id,lease_lineage_id,holder_authority_digest}` — stable identity deliberately excludes grant and lease generations. `PortableRestoreSourceLeaseStateDigest` is `BLAKE3("fgdb.restore-source-lease-state.v1" || canonical(lease_identity,generation,selected_grant_generation_and_digest,window_profile_domain_epoch_and_bounds,archive_counter,holder_and_subject_set_commitment))` — derived entirely from portable archive-authority state, never a keyed local ObjectId.

Prebootstrap: `PreBootstrapRestoreSourceLeaseOwner` is a registered prebootstrap artifact (not a logical object) holding identity, generation, portable state digest, acquire/renew receipt artifact refs, selected grant generation/digest, `PortableArchiveGrantLineageProof`, optional `LeaseWindowSuccessorProof`, `PortableRestoreSourceLeaseLineageProof`, time window, counter, journal head/dispatch state, and relocation-chain commitment — deliberately **no inode, path, local mirror identity, or mutable dispatch-root locator**. The terminal payload must journal the complete signed lineage proof before the owner becomes Current; a digest-only result is invalid after restart or relocation. Acquire creates generation one; prebootstrap renewal creates `g+1` and advances Current; a stale mirror that cannot prove the current head/relocation chain is unusable. The archive authority keeps a reference-free CAS-linear `RestoreSourceLeaseAuthorityHead`; provider no-effect evidence is action-tagged (`RestoreSourceLeaseAcquireOperationTombstone` etc.).

`LeaseWindowSuccessorProof` is `SameEpochNonshrinking{lease_identity,prior_and_successor_generations,same_profile_domain_epoch,prior_and_successor_bounds,checked_nonshrinking_bounds_and_counter,archive_authority_signature}|CrossEpochHandoff{...,dual_signed_transition_proof,no_gap_coverage_proof,checked_domain_mapping,...}` — raw tick comparison across domains or authority epochs is invalid. Lineage history is bounded by `PortableRestoreSourceLeaseLineageCheckpoint` (contiguous range summary: complete generation range, no-fork proof, unchanged holder/subject/inventory, operation accumulator, retention certificate) and `PortableRestoreSourceLeaseLineageProof` (basis Genesis|Checkpointed + per-generation commitments after basis).

Canonical: `RestoreSourceLeaseRecord<Role:AuthorityOwningRole>` imports the latest prebootstrap generation (not necessarily one) with a full `AuthorityBoundHeader<Role>`; renewal constructs `prior+1`, preserves stable identities/subject sets, advances the counter, carries exact successor + lineage proofs; the prior visible registry strongly owns the old record until renewal finalize is visible, then a weak predecessor digest + lineage proof/checkpoint replaces the strong chain. Shards hold only `ShardRestoreSourceLeaseProjection` (Bootstrap via certified `RestoreShardBootstrapProjectionCertificate` or Refresh via typed Meta projection, advancing only `g -> g+1`); a Shard never owns, renews, or releases a lease.

Reference resolution: `RestoreArchiveRef<T> {source:PriorIncarnationObjectRef<T>,lease_identity,permitted_inventory_leaf,leaf_proof}` (no strong lease-generation edge); `RestorePublicationArtifactRef<T>` proves the locator row against the lease-bound publication receipt/grant subject set. Before the bridge, resolution uses the current prebootstrap owner; afterward Local/Meta require the latest canonical live record, Shard the current certified projection — plus subject-preserving grant lineage, `TimeValidationEvidence::Usable`, and exact inventory/grant proofs.

Registry/state machine: `RestoreRegistry` is role-tagged with `activity:Idle|OneLive{restore_id}` — more than one live restore is unencodable. `RestoreLeaseState<Role>` is exactly `Current{latest_lease_record_ref}|RenewAuthorizedUndispatched{...,resume_phase_commitment}|RenewalClosed{...,renewal_close_record_ref}|ReleaseAuthorizedUndispatched{...,completion_evidence_ref}`. Renewal is legal in every hidden/recovery phase that still needs the source (including RecoveryAbandoned); `RestoreSourceKeyAccessCleanupFinalizeSpec` enters AwaitingSourceRelease only by proving no unresolved renewal and atomically creating `RestoreSourceLeaseRenewalCloseRecord` (zero authorized/Armed/SentUnknown/import-pending renewal proof); release is legal only from AwaitingSourceRelease + RenewalClosed. A lease operation freezes the exact restore phase. If a renew authorization becomes audit-visible but eligibility expires before Armed, `RestoreSourceLeaseRenewAuthorizedNeverArmedFinalizeSpec` consumes it with a zero-attempt-membership proof and a permanent nonreuse tombstone (no `DispatchNeverSentProof` needed — that exists only after Armed); release has the symmetric spec. Every terminal (Applied/NeverSent/NoEffect/AuthorizedNeverArmed) appends exactly one `RestoreLeaseOperationTerminalIndex` entry; the checked `RestoreLeaseOperationTerminalAccumulator` supports status/nonreuse after the detailed replay floor closes (`Detailed|Compacted` history). Release runs the universal four-stage protocol and only after the release candidate's `PortableSemanticVisibilityCertificate` exists may dispatch initialize; the lease stays live through independent target reopen and the post-open completion record.

## Invariants & claim types
FG-INV-16 (excerpt): no restore-source lease is lost, duplicated, refunded, released, or exposed while obligated. FG-INV-19 (excerpt): Archived evidence must be **active** for Replayable grade — expired/revoked leases downgrade replay attributably. FG-INV-07 (receipts/proofs never name enclosing future objects). Lease-renewal latency/window headroom are slo class.

## Interactions
Consumes `w11-backup-publication` (grants, receipts, descriptors, authority heads), `w2-continuity-profiles` (holder identity/incarnation), `w9-time-authority` (windows, `TimeValidationEvidence`). Gates every archive access in `w11-restore`; the W12 arms feed `w12-backup-restore`.

## Acceptance criteria & tests
Lineage: forged/forked/skipped head chains rejected; checkpoint omitting a generation or an unresolved operation rejected. Relocation: move the prebootstrap cache inode; owner resolves via relocation chain; stale mirror unusable. Renewal races: expiry-before-Armed takes the AuthorizedNeverArmed path with permanent tombstone; post-Armed only never-sent/status/no-effect/applied paths. Release ordering: release before RenewalClosed unencodable; renewal after RenewalClosed uninhabitable. Crash rows at acquire journal, canonical import, each renewal stage, close, release authorize/dispatch/finalize. E2e with logs: acquire -> bridge import -> two renewals (one cross-epoch) -> close -> release against a simulated authority; logs record generation, head CAS version, and window bounds at each step.

## Risks & rejected alternatives
Rejected: reusing the source backup pin as restore authority; digest-only acquisition results (unrecoverable after restart); unbounded strong lease-record chains (checkpointed lineage instead); shard-owned leases. Risk: lease expiry mid-restore — renewal is legal in every needing phase, and expiry alone never forces release (the cleanup contract stays retryable).

## Provenance
§16.6 (line 1200), App A lines 2225-2235, 2343-2347, 2387-2407; App F FG-INV-07/16/19.

### Verification-layer classification
The task-specific checks above must be registered in the universal verification contract as distinct unit, property/model/mutation or fuzz, simulation/concurrency/fault, and E2E rows rather than one aggregate test. The unit layer exhaustively covers every locally owned canonical type, validator, state-transition arm, arithmetic/boundary rule, error mapping, and gate/manifest evaluator, including invalid and unavailable-feature cases. Property/model tests vary every normative field and legal transition boundary and compare against an independent oracle where one exists. Simulation covers cancellation, crash/restart, virtual time, authority/configuration change, and obligation ownership wherever applicable. The E2E row proves public composition and cannot substitute for a missing unit/property row. Each row names its diagnostic-event schema, fixture profile, deterministic seed or vector, retained evidence artifacts, and one replay command; the owning gate fails if any owned row is absent, waived without an allowed expiring waiver, or reported only through an undifferentiated green bar.

title: Implement prior-incarnation lease barrier and restore reservation consume/burn protocol
description:
## What & scope
Implement prior-incarnation lease cohort fencing/closure and the complete restore reservation Claim/Consume/Burn protocol, including canonical validation, applied-use identities, first-use publication certificates, conflict quarantine, rollover/expiry, and permanent spent commitments.

## Why
Same-identity restore must prove the prior incarnation cannot still act and must never reuse allocation, catalog, privacy, continuity, or other reserved authority. A claimed reservation that escapes without a durable consume/burn lineage can alias IDs or split authority after crash.

## Design — exact normative contract
Execution is leaves-first. `ReaddressAndReprotect` opens/verifies source bytes, substitutes only earlier target mappings, canonical-encodes, computes the new ObjectId, encrypts under new AEAD AAD containing that ObjectId, computes CiphertextId, builds complete encoding/placement/opener/wrap records, and verifies recoverability. Changed bodies cannot reuse old ciphertext. Historical external signatures are carried byte-identically and never presented as target authority; current configurations/certificates/keys/trust are recreated. The completed `RecoveryIncarnationProjectionResult<Role> {plan_ref:StrongRef<RecoveryIncarnationTransformPlan<Role>>,source_recovery_projection_digest,sorted_source_to_target_entries[],target_semantic_root_recipes,target_protocol_reconstruction_recipes,target_prepared_root_recipes,target_consensus_bootstrap_recipes,target_bootstrap_and_physical_inventory,target_availability_certificates,carried_prior_evidence_registry_root,invalidated_or_suspended_capability_and_protocol_owner_root,recreated_current_authority_root,no_missing_duplicate_or_unclassified_entry_proof,posture_preservation_proof,applied_visible_nonwidening_proof,semantic_equivalence_digest,plane_complete_slot_coverage_proof,complete_field_and_object_coverage_digest}` exists before any bridge and names no future root. RecoverSameIdentity preserves the applied/visible gap and pending queue. Clone accepts only CloneExportReady or explicit hidden-entry dispositions, and no recipe transplants source Raft hard state as current target consensus state.

The prior-incarnation barrier is per issuer and per homogeneous lease cohort, with future receipt values represented only as typed holes. `PriorLeaseCohortInventoryRecipe` is the pre-fence reference-free `{cohort_recipe_id,continuity_domain_id,database_security_namespace_id,prior_incarnation,issuer_id,issuer_configuration_identity_and_digest,issuer_authority_epoch,time_authority_profile_oid,time_domain_id,time_authority_epoch,permitted_scope_set,permitted_generation_and_counter_ranges,maximum_issued_generation,source_issuance_ledger_inventory_root_and_configuration_proof_digest,issuance_fence_receipt_digest_hole,cohort_fence_closure_row_digest_hole,final_window_digest_hole}`. A cohort may contain only leases whose issuer, authority/profile/domain epochs, scope class, and counter/generation range interpretation are identical; mixed profile/domain/epoch leases are split before planning. `CohortDispositionDecisionRecipe` is `{cohort_recipe_id,decision_policy:ExpiredOnlyWithDefinitivePreBootstrapAttestationOtherwiseRevoke,revoke_operation_id,revoke_idempotency_digest,revoke_action_body_template_with_fence_receipt_and_window_digest_holes,expiry_attestation_subject_template,cleanup_recipe}`. RestoreFencePending and the Phase-A plan commit the exact sorted recipe/decision sets and pre-minted revoke operation identities—not a future cohort-window or receipt digest. No maximum-lifetime arithmetic or counter-to-time inference is accepted as authority.

`PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortFenceClosureRow` is the portable signed `{cohort_recipe_id,issuer_id,issuer_authority_epoch,time_authority_profile_oid,time_domain_id,time_authority_epoch,covered_generation_and_counter_ranges,last_legal_issuance_or_renewal_counter,maximum_issued_or_renewed_expires_at:AuthorityInstant,issuance_ledger_accumulator_root,range_completeness_proof,source_inventory_configuration_and_recipe_match_digest,no_future_issue_or_renew_for_covered_range:true,row_digest}`. Its `AuthorityInstant` must use the cohort's exact profile/domain/epoch and is the maximum actual expiry found by an authenticated exhaustive issuance-ledger range proof—not a derived duration.

`PriorIncarnationLeaseIssuerFenceReceipt` is the portable `{external_request_binding:ExternalActionRequestBinding{action_kind=PriorIncarnationLeaseIssuerFence},issuer_id,issuer_configuration_identity_and_digest,issuer_authority_epoch,covered_generation_and_counter_ranges,prior_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,result_fenced_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,sorted_cohort_closure_rows[PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortFenceClosureRow],complete_recipe_range_issuance_ledger_and_row_bijection,last_legal_issuance_or_renewal_counter,global_no_future_prior_incarnation_issue_or_renew:true,issuer_counter,signer_set_epoch,signatures}`. After that receipt is terminally imported, the journal fills each matching typed hole and constructs exact `PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortWindow {cohort_recipe_id,issuer_fence_receipt_digest,cohort_closure_row_bytes_and_digest,time_authority_profile_oid,time_domain_id,time_authority_epoch,covered_generation_and_counter_ranges,maximum_issued_or_renewed_expires_at,issuance_ledger_accumulator_and_range_completeness_commitment,window_digest}`. For each exact window it durably selects `CohortDispositionDecision = Expired{prebootstrap_expiry_attestation_artifact_ref}` only when a definitive `PreBootstrapPortableTimeExpiryAttestation` for that same profile/domain/epoch proves `observation_interval.earliest >= maximum_issued_or_renewed_expires_at`; otherwise it selects `Revoke{precommitted_operation_id_and_filled_action_body}`. An expiry crossing after planning is therefore resolved from current evidence, never from a stale guessed decision.

`PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortRevocationReceipt` is the distinct portable `{external_request_binding:ExternalActionRequestBinding{action_kind=PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortRevoke},issuer_id,cohort_key,cohort_window_digest,covered_generation_and_counter_subrange,prior_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,result_revoked_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,no_future_use_proof,issuer_counter,signer_set_epoch,signatures}`. Both actions use the restore-prebootstrap dispatch plane and action-specific source gate. The revoke request must be the filled version of the precommitted template and retain the same operation/idempotency identities; a different window or post-fence operation is not equivalent.

`PriorIncarnationLeaseIssuerFenceRow` is the reference-free portable projection `{issuer_id,issuer_kind:OnlineContinuity|OfflineIssuer,issuer_configuration_identity_and_digest,issuer_authority_epoch,covered_generation_and_counter_ranges,predecessor_head_digest_and_cas_version,resulting_fenced_head_digest_and_cas_version,fence_receipt_identity_and_digest,sorted_cohort_closure_row_digests,complete_recipe_range_and_row_bijection,terminal_evidence_identity_and_digest,no_future_prior_incarnation_issue_or_renew:true,issuer_counter}`. `PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortDisposition` is exactly `Revoked{cohort_recipe_id,cohort_window_digest,cohort_closure_row_digest,decision_record_digest,issuer_fence_row_key,covered_generation_and_counter_subrange,revocation_operation_id,revocation_receipt_identity_and_digest,terminal_evidence_identity_and_digest}|Expired{cohort_recipe_id,cohort_window_digest,cohort_closure_row_digest,maximum_issued_or_renewed_expires_at,decision_record_digest,prebootstrap_portable_expiry_attestation_identity_and_digest}`. An Expired arm is legal only when the separately imported prebootstrap attestation's subject, profile, time domain, authority epoch, window, maximum expiry, basis, and intended barrier action equal that cohort; a Revoked arm is legal only when the issuer's fenced ranges cover the cohort completely and the action is the filled precommitted template. No receipt, expiry, or time-domain mapping is inferred from a successor head, counter, nominal lifetime, or unaddressable inline pseudo-object.

`LeasesRevokedOrExpiredThrough` is the external reference-free certificate `{database_security_namespace_id,continuity_profile_id,restore_id,prior_incarnation,planned_target_incarnation,current_restore_fence_pending_digest,current_cas_version,cohort_inventory_recipe_set_digest,cohort_disposition_decision_recipe_set_digest,exact_issuer_configuration_set_commitment,sorted_issuer_fence_rows[PriorIncarnationLeaseIssuerFenceRow],exact_cohort_window_set_commitment,sorted_cohort_dispositions[PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortDisposition],complete_recipe_to_window_to_decision_to_action_or_attestation_bijection,complete_issuer_and_cohort_bijection_commitment,no_future_prior_incarnation_lease_issuance_or_renewal_proof,authority_tick,signer_set_epoch,threshold_signatures}`. It intentionally names the already-existing RestoreFencePending head and planned target, never the later RestoreReserved result. Mixed Revoked and Expired cohorts are normal; there is no all-revoked/all-expired union, cross-issuer maximum generation, cross-epoch scalar expiry, or unsigned range shortcut.

Barrier signing is not a hidden external side effect. The `EnterRestoreReserved` request carries the complete unsigned barrier body/row commitment through `PriorLeaseBarrierCompleteGate`. The continuity authority verifies every issuer/cohort receipt, expiry attestation, no-future-issuance proof, and bijection; in one registered CAS operation it signs the portable barrier naming the existing RestoreFencePending head, computes its digest, and CASes the direct RestoreReserved successor that commits that digest. `EnterRestoreReservedReceipt` begins with `ExternalActionRequestBinding{action_kind=EnterRestoreReserved}` and contains `{prior_fence_pending_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,signed_barrier_bytes_and_digest,result_restore_reserved_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,target_incarnation,plan_and_journal_commitment,continuity_counter,signer_set_epoch,threshold_signatures}`. Thus the signed barrier and result head are returned together, with no future-reference cycle or separate signing call.

Before target `K_oid`, RestoreReserved consumes only the portable barrier digest plus the sealed prebootstrap action/artifact lineage committed by its source gate; a local barrier-import ObjectId cannot yet exist. `PortableRestoreContinuityAncestryProof` is the reference-free authority-signed `{restore_id,target_incarnation,ordered_heads[{transition_kind:EnterRestoreFencePending|EnterRestoreReserved|CommitAcquisitionRefinementBootstrapOpeners|CommitAcquisitionRefinementVerifiedObjectInventory,head_bytes_digest,cas_version,predecessor_head_digest,operation_id,canonical_request_digest}],enter_restore_reserved_receipt_digest,barrier_digest,current_head_bytes_digest_and_cas_version,allowed_chain_complete:true,continuity_counter,signer_set_epoch,threshold_signatures}`. The chain must begin at the exact FencePending head, include the exact receipt-returned RestoreReserved successor, then contain zero or the two ordered refinement successors and no other transition.

After target `K_oid` exists but still before the first RootManifest, creation constructs `PriorIncarnationLeaseBarrierBootstrapImport<Role:AuthorityOwningRole> {authority_bound_header:AuthorityBoundHeader<Role>,role_and_group,restore_fence_pending_record_ref:StrongRef<ClusterIncarnationContinuityRecord>,cohort_inventory_and_decision_recipe_set_commitment,sorted_cohort_window_refs[StrongRef<PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortWindow>],portable_barrier_ref:StrongRef<LeasesRevokedOrExpiredThrough>,enter_restore_reserved_receipt_ref:StrongRef<EnterRestoreReservedReceipt>,enter_restore_reserved_terminal_evidence_ref:StrongRef<PortableExternalActionTerminalEvidence<EnterRestoreReserved>>,enter_restore_reserved_prebootstrap_terminal_import_artifact_identity_bytes_and_digest,continuity_ancestry_proof_ref:StrongRef<PortableRestoreContinuityAncestryProof>,sorted_issuer_fence_imports[{issuer_row_key,fence_receipt_ref:StrongRef<PriorIncarnationLeaseIssuerFenceReceipt>,portable_terminal_evidence_ref:StrongRef<PortableExternalActionTerminalEvidence<PriorIncarnationLeaseIssuerFence>>,prebootstrap_terminal_import_artifact_identity_bytes_and_digest}],sorted_expired_cohort_imports[{cohort_window_ref:StrongRef<PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortWindow>,prebootstrap_time_validation_evidence_artifact_identity_and_digest,prebootstrap_portable_expiry_attestation_ref:StrongRef<PreBootstrapPortableTimeExpiryAttestation>,historical_time_profile_and_verifier_evidence_commitment}],sorted_revoked_cohort_imports[{cohort_window_ref:StrongRef<PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortWindow>,issuer_fence_row_key,decision_record_digest,revocation_receipt_ref:StrongRef<PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortRevocationReceipt>,portable_terminal_evidence_ref:StrongRef<PortableExternalActionTerminalEvidence<PriorIncarnationLeaseCohortRevoke>>,prebootstrap_terminal_import_artifact_identity_bytes_and_digest}],sealed_prebootstrap_journal_lineage_commitment,complete_recipe_window_decision_issuer_cohort_disposition_action_and_artifact_bijection_commitment,complete_transcript_match_digest,body_digest}`. It deliberately contains no current RootSlot/manifest publication commitment, ordinary `ContinuityAuthorityObservationImport`, `TimeAuthorityObservationImport`, or canonical `TimeValidationEvidence`; those would create a pre-first-root cycle. Each issuer row has exactly one typed fence artifact import, each Expired cohort has exactly one prebootstrap validation/portable attestation import, and each Revoked cohort has exactly one action-typed receipt/evidence/artifact import.

After the bridge RootSlot is durable, the recovery-only ordered `PriorIncarnationLeaseBarrierCanonicalValidateSpec<Role>` consumes that bootstrap import plus the exact current role root/configuration/writer-fence publication, a current `ContinuityAuthorityObservationImport<Role>` whose head equals the ancestry proof's allowed current descendant, and retained historical time-profile/verifier/registry-ancestry evidence for every Expired cohort. It does **not** require a fresh challenge to a retired old time epoch: expiry is monotone once a preserved signed attestation proves `observation_interval.earliest >= expires_at`, while fresh current continuity ancestry still proves no later prior-incarnation issuance path reopened. It creates `PriorIncarnationLeaseBarrierCanonicalValidationRecord<Role> {authority_bound_header:AuthorityBoundHeader<Role>,bootstrap_import_ref:StrongRef<PriorIncarnationLeaseBarrierBootstrapImport<Role>>,current_configuration_writer_fence_and_publication_commitment,continuity_observation_import_ref:StrongRef<ContinuityAuthorityObservationImport<Role>>,sorted_expired_cohort_validations[{cohort_window_ref,prebootstrap_portable_expiry_attestation_ref:StrongRef<PreBootstrapPortableTimeExpiryAttestation>,historical_time_profile_ref,historical_verifier_key_and_retirement_floor_ref,historical_registry_ancestry_proof_ref,attestation_signature_window_and_subject_validation_digest}],exact_current_head_ancestry_recipe_window_decision_and_all_evidence_match_digest,assigned_role_maintenance_identity,body_digest}`. Restore reconciliation retains the bootstrap import until this record and its audit visibility are durable; readiness, Shard bootstrap projection, promotion, and ordinary service require the canonical validation record. Thus initial creation is acyclic, old valid backups do not depend on a long-retired clock service, and post-root operation still proves current continuity authority.

`ShardPriorIncarnationLeaseBarrierProjection` is the certified Meta projection `{source_meta_prefix,source_meta_configuration_identity,restore_id,prior_and_target_incarnations,barrier_identity_and_digest,meta_canonical_validation_record_identity_and_digest,complete_issuer_cohort_bijection_commitment,typed_projection_payload_identity_and_digest,projection_certificate_ref:CertifiedRemoteStrongRef<MetaControlProjectionCertificate>,retention_grant_and_payload_availability_evidence,body_digest}` using the exact `TypedCertifiedMetaProjectionPayload::PriorIncarnationLeaseBarrier` arm after `PriorIncarnationLeaseBarrierCanonicalValidationRecord<Meta>` is durable and audit-visible. A Shard never imports raw continuity authority, reservation heads, fence receipts, or local time evidence. An authenticated advanced head uses exact `ReservationExternalSuccessorReconcileSpec<Role> {expected_registry_record_ref,current_authority_observation_import_ref,winning_head_ref:StrongRef<ReservationAuthorityHead>,winning_operation_request_status_and_typed_receipt_lineage,local_claim_and_applied_use_commitment?,complete_equivalence_or_conflict_proof,terminal_audit_gate}`.
